title: Variorum Record
description: A sidecar record identifying, tracing and attesting one immutable artifact. Specification version 0.1.0-draft.

name.description: SCH-2: a lowercase name. The reserved table in spec/02-scheme.md is informative; any other name is opaque to consumers.

promptField.description: REC-24: the name the provider uses for the field whose value 'prompt' holds (REC-23), for example 'lyrics'. It cannot appear without 'prompt'; its absence means the mapping is unspecified, not that the generator has a single field.

determinism.description: REC-12: SHOULD be one of none, seeded, content or full (see spec/04-recipe.md). Deliberately unconstrained here: a SHOULD is not a validity rule, and an enum or a type would turn an unrecognised grade into a schema rejection the specification does not authorise (CON-8, ADR-0005).

state.description: The lifecycle the record declares. With no transitions, `current` states a premise: `draft` (the artifact may still change) or `candidate` (complete, and nothing has been decided about it). Every other state asserts a decision and requires a transition with an actor and a timestamp (STA-7, STA-9, ADR-0017).

propertyNames.description: CORE-10 recommends a '<prefix>:<name>' form but does not require it; the prefix is optional in this pattern so that a warning is not turned into a schema rejection.

variorum:conformance.description: CON-5: the classes the record claims. CON-6 requires each declared class other than core to be backed by its member.

variorum:semver.description: SEM-1: the claim that this record's 'semver' label has been checked against the SemVer 2.0.0 bridge (spec/90-extensions/semver.md). Absence of this member means the label is opaque (SCH-7) and no bridge rule applies.

tag.description: SEM-5: the release tag as published. It must end with the version's precedence part; that comparison needs scheme.version, so only the shape is expressed here.

variorum:c2pa.description: C2P-1: the claim that this record points at a C2PA 2.2 manifest (spec/90-extensions/c2pa.md). The claim is a reference, never a copy of the manifest.

manifest.description: C2P-2: the URN of the active manifest (C2PA 2.2 §8.1): the urn:c2pa: namespace, a UUID, and C2PA’s optional components, which this bridge does not parse.

location.description: C2P-3: whether the manifest store travels inside the artifact's bytes or beside them.

uri.description: C2P-4: where an external manifest store is retrievable, as an absolute URI reference.

variorum:swhid.description: SWH-1: the claim that this record cites a Software Heritage identifier (spec/90-extensions/swhid.md). The identifier is a sibling claim, never the artifact's identity (SWH-6, ADR-0012).

swhid.description: SWH-2: one SWHID of scheme version 1 (SWHID 1.2 §4, §5.1), stored as the archive emitted it. SWH-5: no fragment qualifier, because a record identifies a whole artifact. The qualifier combinations of SWH-4 depend on the object type and on the other qualifiers; JSON Schema cannot express those, so the reference tool enforces them.

variorum:spdx.description: SPDX-1: the claim that this record cites the SPDX document describing the artifact's contents (spec/90-extensions/spdx.md). The claim is a pointer and carries no checksum: an SPDX SHA256 checksum can equal artifact.digest, and that equality is a reader's comparison, never a copy (SPDX-6, ADR-0013).

version.description: SPDX-2: the SPDXVersion the claim is written against (SPDX 2.3.1 §6.1), without the 'SPDX-' prefix. 2.3 and 2.3.1 share the document model; 3.0 does not, so it is refused until a bridge revision defines it.

document.description: SPDX-3: the document namespace (§6.5) — a unique absolute URI with a scheme and no fragment, because '#' is reserved for element URIs (§7.2, §8.2).

element.description: SPDX-4: the SPDX identifier of the package or file element that describes this artifact (§7.2, §8.2). Absent means the claim points at the document without naming an element; SPDXRef-DOCUMENT is refused because a document is not one of the things it describes.

variorum:prov.description: PROV-1: the claim that this record projects onto the W3C PROV family as spec/90-extensions/prov.md fixes it (ADR-0014). A projection, not a pointer: the claim names the edition and carries nothing to copy, because PROV gives a document no required identity (PROV-CONSTRAINTS §1.2) and reserves no attribute that hashes bytes (§5.7.2).

version.description: PROV-2: the PROV family as recommended on 30 April 2013. PROV is not versioned — the family was published once — so a date is the only edition there is.

allOf.description: ID-8: the id must be derived from the digest.

then.$comment: Equality of the hex components is enforced by tools/variorum.py (ID-8); JSON Schema cannot express cross-field substring equality.
